subject: [PATCH RFC v4 05/12] mm/gup: add get_user_page_vma() to fault in a page under a held lock

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function, get_user_page_vma(), which allows faulting in a single page under a held lock. The function is designed to be used by __access_remote_vm() when it needs to access a page that is not already present in the page tables. It takes advantage of the existing VMA locking mechanism and simplifies the process of accessing remote memory. If the fault cannot complete under the per-VMA lock, the function releases the lock and returns -EAGAIN for both the mmap lock and the per-VMA lock. The patch also updates the handling of VM_FAULT_ERROR to return -EFAULT instead of BUG().
